item.title: During Helene, I just wanted a plain text website
item.description:
📝 We tried to find out the situation with the highways on the government site that tracks road closures. Especially ones with this sort of info. At that time, even a plain text site with barely any styles or images would have been better.
🔗 Read more: https://sparkbox.com/foundry/helene_and_mobile_web_performance
